verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing copy claims a built-in AI feature ('Describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you') suggesting an in-product assistant that can build flows/segments from natural language, but there is no documentation detailing what this assistant does, its scope, or how a user interacts with it — most AI-related evidence (MCP, CLI, Skills) describes external agents connecting to Bento rather than a built-in assistant delegated to by the user. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/UI walkthrough of the built-in assistant, examples of tasks it can perform, and independent/hands-on confirmation it works as described.
